lines.text: Previously. Gideon built me a harness, so the axe can block exactly once.
Someone opened a Rift through the floor of his forge. From inside the town.
Sieg says a man in a black suit opens doors for monsters.
lines.tts: Seeg says a man in a black suit opens doors for monsters.

lines.text: And he's interested in me.
Easy now. Easy. River's quiet tonight.
Quiet as a grave. Never heard her this quiet.
What's that? Lights. Under the water.
One. Two. Five. Seven...
Those are eyes.
Are we there yet?
No.
Are we there now?
You asked that four seconds ago.
Four seconds is a long time when your head is on fire.
Sieg. Tell us about the job again. Slowly. So he stops asking.
lines.tts: Seeg. Tell us about the job again. Slowly. So he stops asking.

lines.text: Marrowmere. A river town built on stilts, where the Varrow opens into a lake.
Three nights ago, a ferryman saw seven lights rise out of the water. The next morning the ferry was gone. So was half the east dock.
Seven lights. That's a lot of lights.
Seven heads, Nemu. The ferryman wasn't counting carefully. He was running.
lines.tts: Seven heads, Neh-moo. The ferryman wasn't counting carefully. He was running.

lines.text: A Hydra. The Guild records say one was sealed under that lake two hundred years ago.
Sealed by who?
A Hunter named Maren. She cut off its heads for nine days, until she ran out of strength.
Then she tied it to the lake bed, and drowned with it.
...I'd like to go back to the part where we were asking if we were there yet.
Every head you cut grows back. That is the problem. And our boy only knows how to cut.
Break. I break things.
Then you're about to learn the difference between breaking a thing and killing it.
Oh, I like this one. A monster you can't kill by hitting it. You'll hate it, boy.
You sound happy about that.
I'm always happy when you suffer. It's the only entertainment in here.
Who are you talking to?
Nobody.
He talks to the axe. It's fine. I talk to graves.
That is not reassuring.
It's not supposed to be. It's just true.
Fresh river eel! Two coppers!
Hunters! The Guild sent Hunters!
It smells like fish. Everything smells like fish. Even the air is a fish.
I like it.
You like everything that smells like food.
I like everything that is food.
Hunters from Ashford! Welcome to the Marrowmere branch of the Hunters' Guild!
...Weren't you in Ashford?
That was my cousin. We are all cousins. Please do not ask.
How many cousins?
Enough. Please do not ask.
The commission is rank B. The east docks are evacuated. Nobody has been eaten. Yet.
Yet?
The fishermen keep going out. Fishermen are like that.
Has anyone seen it in daylight?
A little girl did. She said it has seven heads, and one of them looked sad.
Sad?
She is six. I wrote it down anyway.
We go out at dawn. Tonight we eat, and we listen.
Eat! Finally a part of the job I'm good at!
You know what I miss most? Not my phone. Not my bed. Vending machines.
Vending machines.
Hot corn soup in a can, at two in the morning, on a cold street. Best thing humanity ever made.
There was one at the crossing. Where I fell through. I used to buy the cat milk there.
Cat milk? In a can?
Coffee milk. The cat liked coffee milk.
That's a terrible thing to give a cat.
It was my friend's cat. He started it. I just kept going.
The friend you came here looking for.
Haruki. Black hair. Blue eyes. He smiled at everyone like they owed him nothing.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee. Black hair. Blue eyes. He smiled at everyone like they owed him nothing.

lines.text: ...Hey. How long ago did he disappear?
Two years.
Last winter, I was on a caravan job near the capital. Saint Lumen. There was talk about a new Skyfallen in the Gilded Order. Young. Black hair.
They said he could freeze a Fiend mid-swing. Just stop it. Like pausing a video.
Did you see him?
No. The Order keeps its Skyfallen behind white walls. We never see them. They have better things than corn soup.
...Saint Lumen.
Don't make that face. It's the face people make before they do something stupid.
I don't have a face.
Everybody has a face, man. Even me. Mine's just on fire.
This fish is incredible. In Osaka, we'd fry it. Here they just wave it near a fire, and it's still incredible.
lines.tts: This fish is incredible. In Oh-sah-kah, we'd fry it. Here they just wave it near a fire, and it's still incredible.

lines.text: Are you going to eat the head?
I wasn't planning to.
Mm.
She took it. She just took the head.
Takuto. About tomorrow. If it regrows heads, we need a plan that isn't hit it until it stops.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. About tomorrow. If it regrows heads, we need a plan that isn't hit it until it stops.

lines.text: That plan has worked so far.
That plan almost got you crushed by a Behemoth.
Almost.
She's right. So far you've only fought things that stay broken.
Rin. Your threads. You said they tie two things so they move together.
Whatever happens to one happens to the other. Tie your ankle to a falling tree, and you fall.
You did that to someone?
To my brother. Once. He deserved it.
How many things can you tie at once?
Two is easy. Three is hard. More than three, I've never tried.
Seven?
...You want me to tie seven heads together.
If they move together, maybe they break together.
That's insane.
It's not insane. It's untested. That's different.
What about me? What do I do?
You keep the water warm.
Warm?
Hydras are cold things. Heat makes them slow, and angry. Mostly angry.
Great. Angry. My specialty.
And me?
You stay on the dock.
I have two lives left. That's two more than you.
That's why you stay on the dock.
...Fine. I'll stay on the dock. I'll be very bored on the dock.
She won't stay on the dock.
I know.
Quiet.
Too quiet.
Can we not say that? Every time somebody says that, something comes out of the water.
The water's moving.
I SAID NOT TO SAY IT!
Seven heads. Gods. The child was right.
Takuto. One head. Just one. Show me what happens.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. One head. Just one. Show me what happens.

lines.text: Break!
It's growing back!
It grew back TWO!
That's not fair.
Nothing that lives is fair, boy. Cut a weed, it comes back thicker.
Takuto!
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh!

lines.text: Afterimage!
Back to the dock! Everyone back! We've seen enough!
I can take another one.
You can take another eight. That's the problem. Back!
Back, back, back! Hot water! Very hot water!
It's going back down.
It's not running. It's waiting.
The middle head. It didn't attack. Not once.
The sad one.
Every cut, it doubles. Fight it head by head, and by sunset it has a hundred.
Then I stop cutting heads.
Then what do you cut? That's the question, Takuto.
lines.tts: Then what do you cut? That's the question, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: I went to the town archive. Maren, the Hunter who sealed it. She wrote one line before she went into the lake.
The heads are not the Hydra.
Then what is?
She didn't write that part.
Classic. Great. Thank you, Maren.
The sad head never bit. It just watched. Like it was being carried.
The heart. A Hydra's heart sits in one head. The others are arms. Hungry arms.
So I break the middle one.
The others guard it. You'd never reach it alone.
Unless the others can't move without it.
Your threads.
I tie the six to the seventh. They move as one. Whatever happens to the heart happens to all of them.
One strike.
One strike. And there's a catch.
There is always a catch.
To hold seven, I have to be the knot. They will be tied to me, too. If you miss, and it dives...
You go into the lake with it.
Like Maren.
Then we don't do it.
We do it. That's the job.
The job isn't drowning.
Don't decide what I risk, Takuto. You don't get to do that. Nobody does.
lines.tts: Don't decide what I risk, Tah-koo-toh. You don't get to do that. Nobody does.

lines.text: Enough. Both of you.
Rin, it's your Brand and your life. Takuto, it's your strike. If either of you isn't sure, we wait for reinforcements.
lines.tts: Rin, it's your Brand and your life. Tah-koo-toh, it's your strike. If either of you isn't sure, we wait for reinforcements.

lines.text: How long do reinforcements take?
Two weeks.
And how many heads by then?
I don't do math that sad, Wick.
Tonight. While it's still only nine.
You're angry with me.
I'm angry with the lake.
...You can't break a lake.
I haven't tried.
My brother used to say I tie things so they don't fall apart. Shoes. Sails. People.
He said it was the opposite of his Brand. He broke things. Like you.
What happened to him?
A Rift opened over our village. He went in after the thing that came out. I tied a thread to his wrist so I could pull him back.
The thread went slack.
So, no. I'm not going to drown. I'm not going to let you watch someone go slack.
The axe can't block, Rin. If it goes for you, I can't stand in front of you.
Then don't block. Pull.
Pull?
I'll tie a thread to your wrist, too. If I go under, you pull. You're strong enough. You're too stubborn not to be.
...I won't miss.
I know. That's why I'm doing it.
Tied to a girl with a temper. Boy, you have terrible luck. I approve.
You're not sleeping either.
Old men don't sleep before a fight. We count.
Count what?
Who is standing where. Who is too brave. Who will do something stupid.
Takuto.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: Takuto. And Rin. And you.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. And Rin. And you.

lines.text: I'm not stupid. I'm lazy. It's different.
You have two lives left, Nemu. You said so to him like it was a lot.
lines.tts: You have two lives left, Neh-moo. You said so to him like it was a lot.

lines.text: It is a lot. Most people have one.
My squad had one each. Eleven people. Eleven lives. I counted them every night, the way I'm counting you.
One morning I counted, and I got to one.
...Does it get easier? Counting?
No. But it's better than not counting. If you stop, you forget they were ever there.
Then count me. I'll still be here in the morning. Probably asleep.
...Deal. Go sleep for an hour. I'll wake you when the sky starts yelling.
Okay. Takoyaki left. Takoyaki right. Let's boil a lake.
Will-o'-Wisp! Only the water! Only the WATER!
It's coming up. Angry. Good. Angry things make mistakes.
Nine heads now.
Don't cut. Don't cut. Don't cut.
Mine!
Afterimage! I'll keep the outer heads busy. Rin, start!
Red Thread. One. Two. Three.
Four... five...
It's heavy. It's so heavy.
I can't reach the middle one! The others keep it back!
Hey! Sad head! Over here!
Nemu! The dock!
lines.tts: Neh-moo! The dock!

lines.text: I was bored on the dock!
Look at me, not them!
Hey! Leave the cat girl alone! Takoyaki, LEFT!
Rin, faster! I can't hold the outer heads much longer!
Six! It turned! Seven!
Gideon, your chains, now!
Two blocks in two weeks. You're getting soft.
Seven heads! One knot! Takuto, NOW!
lines.tts: Seven heads! One knot! Tah-koo-toh, NOW!

lines.text: Ruinbreaker!
It's diving! It's pulling me!
I've got you!
Pull, boy. Pull like you mean it.
You... pulled.
You said pull.
I didn't think you'd listen.
It's done. All of it. Every head went still at once.
I boiled a lake. I boiled an entire lake. Nobody is ever going to believe me.
I believe you. I can smell it.
The lake is calm! The lake is calm!
The Hunters did it!
Free eel for the Hunters! Free eel, all day!
Free eel.
Go. You earned it.
I earned two.
On behalf of the Marrowmere branch, thank you. I have filed the report. I wrote down that the sad head stopped looking sad.
Did it?
The little girl says so. She watched from her roof. I am choosing to believe her.
Takuto. Come look at this.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Come look at this.

lines.text: What is it?
The seal stone. From the lake bed. It washed up this morning. Look at the edge.
It's burned. Like something melted it from the inside.
It smells like a burnt phone charger.
Static.
The Hydra didn't wake up. Someone woke it, and aimed it at a town full of people.
And there were feathers on the shore. Black and red. Big ones.
Plume Ogre feathers. They don't come this far south. Something is pushing them.
Oh! And a hawk came from Ashford an hour ago. For you, Mister Valen.
...Fort Cinder. Red Giants marching from the volcanic plain. Every Hunter rank C and above is called to the walls.
That's me.
And me.
And me.
You're rank F, Takuto.
lines.tts: You're rank F, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: I'm an error. Errors go where they want.
...Valentine is going to love you.
Akuro. The middle head. Why was it sad?
lines.tts: Ah-koo-roh. The middle head. Why was it sad?

lines.text: Two hundred years asleep in the mud, chained by a dead woman. Then someone burns the chain and points it at a town.
It wanted to go back to sleep, boy. That's all. Most monsters do.
Did I kill it? Or break it?
Both. You broke its heart, and that killed it. Isn't that wonderful? You're learning.
It doesn't feel wonderful.
That's how you know you're still human. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Seven heads, one knot. He let the girl tie herself to it. How very brave of her.
Next, let's see what he does when he loses.
Next time: Fort Cinder, on the edge of the volcanic plain.
The Red Giants march. And for the first time, I lose control.
Akuro opens his eye. Rin gets hurt. Because of me.
lines.tts: Ah-koo-roh opens his eye. Rin gets hurt. Because of me.

lines.text: Episode six. The Red Giants March.
